purpose: Disregard a classification or avoid relying on a means.
keywords: Anyone may participate regardless of age.
We finished it by hand without relying on machines.
We will hold it indoors regardless of the weather.
restrictions: Context distinguishes regardless of from without relying on.
mistake: Do not confuse it with によって, which can identify a determining factor.
